plan.goal: Create 20-meter buffer polygons around each street centerline
plan.notes: Buffer distance is exactly 20 meters using EPSG:6852 CRS. All 887 LineString street features become 887 buffer Polygon features.

plan.goal: Count street trees falling within each 20-meter street buffer using spatial join
plan.notes: Perform spatial join between buffer polygons and tree point features. Use count aggregation: for each buffer feature, count how many tree points intersect it. The 'id' field from roads_potland_epsg6852_subset identifies each street. The result preserves street geometries enriched with the tree count.
